name: Koldunic Sorcery — 2 Intermediate — Conjure Greater Demon

system.description:
Similar to Conjure Lesser Demon, except that a mighty entity of the Old Country answers the summons. Such a being is not generally subject to intimidation; it must be coaxed to serve and has no qualms about destroying the sorcerer should the offer not be to its liking, which is why koldun rarely invoke this ritual. Like lesser demons, greater demons bear individual names and may appear in any shape.

System: Requires a Blood Point spilled as part of the casting and a successful Intelligence + Hearth Wisdom roll (difficulty 8). Success summons a single named greater demon, but the koldun must immediately begin bargaining for its service; failure to offer adequate tribute may see the demon turn on its summoner.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
system.duration: Until bargain ends or demon is dismissed
